$description: Color / Active — success mode. All values alias the 'success' family from Semantic / Color. Apply this mode to a frame/component to make it success-colored (positive confirmation, completed states). Use in Figma by setting the 'Color / Active' collection mode to 'success'.

color.$description: Primary accent fill for success components

on-color.$description: Text/icon color drawn on top of 'color'

container.$description: Subtle tinted background for success-colored containers

focus.$description: Focus ring color (semi-transparent) for success-colored components
